lines.en: I drag my long tail across the ice.
In the ice spikes, my footing holds.
My claws dig into frozen soil.
I crawl and sweep my tail.
Snow gathers on my back.
I crawl slowly to the ice hollow's rim.
My jaw scrapes the snow. Cold.
I go around a spike of ice.
The ice creaks as I crawl.
Ice water carries my chin along.
My tracks are two deep grooves.
Cold does not trouble me.
I turn halfway and watch the bank.
I squeeze out of an ice crack.
Slow crawl, heavy body.

lines.zh: 雪地上留着我的一串印。
lines.en: One line of prints in the snow.
I lie on the ice without moving.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等热气散出来。
lines.en: Mouth open, I let the warmth out.
Few living things in the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气挂上冰刺。
lines.en: My breath hangs on the ice spikes.
Eyes shut, my ears still move.
The cold makes me patient.
In the snow, I pass for rock.
I wait for a stir under the ice.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴偶尔拍一下冰。
lines.en: My tail slaps the ice now and then.
No food here. I endure.

lines.zh: 我在数冰柱滴水的次数。
lines.en: I count drips from the icicles.

lines.zh: 雪落在我眼睛里，我不眨。
lines.en: Snow lands on my eye. I do not blink.
My hide is thick. Cold means little.
I wait for the wind to drop.

lines.zh: 这冰面不欢迎暖的东西。
lines.en: Warm things are not welcome on this ice.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了我的脚印。
lines.en: Your boots crushed my prints.
I have not seen a living one in a while.
Dressed so thin, you will freeze.
I have more teeth than this ice has spikes.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，是冰最薄处。
lines.en: You stand on the thinnest ice.
I crawl slowly. You are slower.
The ice gator's eyes pick out body heat.
I know this ice.
Do not step back. Water there.
A white cut on my hide.
I growl and give half a block.
My jaw's numb; I'll remember this.
I cracked the ice with my tail.
Ice slides off my back.
I do not cry out. I open my jaws.
Pain makes me steadier.
That spot went numb long ago.
I hold still and wait for more.
This hide was not grown for nothing.
Meat? I prefer it frozen.
That warmth lifts my head.

lines.zh: 放地上，它一会儿就凉了。
lines.en: Set it down. It will cool soon.
I do not eat cooked food.
Not fishy enough.
Toss it farther. I dislike heat.
That fish is good. Frozen solid.
Not to my mouth. I bite hands.
I prefer to dig it out of ice.

lines.zh: 食物在这里不容易腐坏。
lines.en: Food keeps well here.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的侧甲。
lines.en: Your shoulder meets my flank.
I am as heavy as pack ice.
My tail met you first.
One bump and the ice splits.
I have no intention of moving.
You fall back twice. Steady.
My hide is hard. That did nothing.
The ice is slick. You slid to me.
Touch me and your hand numbs.
I cannot be bothered. Here I stay.
What happens under the ice stays there.

lines.zh: 沼泽里的同类比我温和。
lines.en: My swamp kin are gentler than I.
The cold made me what I am.
Asking that, are your hands cold?
No young are raised here.
I have lain alone for years.
Drop it. The wind carries it off.
Better not to ask a gator that.
Survive this winter first.
Silence keeps me a little warmer.
I dig the fish out of the ice.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，冻在地上了。
lines.en: What you dropped froze to the ground.
I take it in my jaws and drag it under.
I bite this ice to pieces.
The meat on the ice is mine.
I chew slowly. No hurry.

lines.zh: 这具甲壳太重，我拖不动。
lines.en: This shell is too heavy to drag.
I pull your arrow with my teeth.
It fell into a crevasse. Shame.
I press it under me to warm it.
I raise my front half.
Under the ice, my tail moves.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气太显眼了。
lines.en: Your heat is too obvious.
I crawl your way.
I aim this bite at a leg.
You backed among the ice spikes.
That shape under the ice is mine.

lines.zh: 冷让我动作变慢，也更准。
lines.en: The cold slows me, and steadies me.
Under the ice, only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 冰面会把你的脚步放大。
lines.en: The ice amplifies your steps.
I follow along the ice.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，冰就响一声。
lines.en: Each step back cracks the ice.
I wait for you to hit that crevasse.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在你身后划了一下。
lines.en: My tail sweeps behind you.
The cold slows your hands.

lines.zh: 我数着你脚下裂开的次数。
lines.en: I count the cracks under you.
You turn; I change angle.
Spikes block your retreat.
I flatten almost to stillness.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声在冰上很远就听见。
lines.en: Your breath carries far on ice.

lines.zh: 我的牙合在你的小腿上。
lines.en: My jaws close on your calf.
My tail sweeps; you slide two blocks.
One bite, and the ice breaks too.
I hold and drag you toward water.
That one came with ice shards.

lines.zh: 你被撞得后退，脚下一滑。
lines.en: The impact sends you sliding.
I bite the arm holding your shield.
Cold gets into the wound. Worse.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，尾巴又扫来。
lines.en: I turn slowly; the tail sweeps again.
You heard a bone crack.
A ridged back surfaces under the ice.

lines.zh: 冰刺之间多了一道影子。
lines.en: A shape among the ice spikes.
The snowdrift moved. It was me.
I break the ice and climb out.
Where it is cold, I come.
The ice under you thickens.

lines.zh: 冰窟里传出低低的响声。
lines.en: A low sound from the hollow.
I have lain here for years.
This ice gully is mine.
I lift my head from the snow.
Fire softens my hide.
I fall into a crevasse and jam.

lines.zh: 水冷得让我的动作更慢。
lines.en: The water is cold and slows me further.
The blast blows a hole in the ice.
An arrow wedges deep between my plates.
Magic stiffens my tail.
Nothing to eat under the ice. I thin.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰面上，碎渣四飞。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice; shards fly.
The ice floor splits, void below.
